results.title: AuthLoadingPage resolves and redirects to home
steps: Verify loader animations and establishing status are displayed.
Wait 1.6 seconds and verify automatic redirect to home page.
results.expectedResult: Page resolves transition and redirects user safely to home.

results.title: SessionExpiredPage warning and re-auth link
steps: Check that clock warning status icon and text are visible.
Click on 'Sign in again' and check redirect to /login.
results.expectedResult: Warning message displayed and sign in link routes to /login.

results.title: LoggedOutPage info and back home actions
results.preconditions: User is signed out and redirected to /session-expired or preview/session.
steps: Check redirect back to home page works.
results.expectedResult: Sign out success title visible and home link redirects.

results.title: AccessDeniedPage redirects and 403 indicators
steps: Verify primary action goes back to home page.
results.expectedResult: Access denied warning appears and routes back to homepage.

results.title: Manual logout navigation
results.preconditions: User is signed in and on customer dashboard `/dashboard`.
steps: Click on the Logout menu item in the TopNav.
results.expectedResult: Navigates to `/login` and destroys session reference.

results.title: SessionTimeoutWarning focus management and accessibility
results.preconditions: User session is idle and warning opens.
steps: Try pressing Tab key to check if focus is trapped or automatically moved to the primary action button.
results.expectedResult: Focus moves to primary action 'Stay signed in' button and user cannot tab outside modal content.
results.actualResult: Focus remains on page background; keyboard focus is not trapped, allowing tab navigation behind the dialog overlay.

results.title: Session state persistence on page reload
results.preconditions: User is active on admin workspace.

results.title: Last active page restoration on re-authentication
results.preconditions: User session has expired on active page.
steps: Store active page path in sessionStorage.
Verify stored page details exist in component state.
results.actualResult: Stored path read successfully from sessionStorage.
